correctness.rationale: A refresh of the observed vertex creates a fair bit; refreshing its full closed neighborhood in the next round prevents any later dependence. Equal fresh opinions at times t-d and t+d make the only two count summands involving the bit sum to twice a fair indicator. Sparse selected times 2d+2 apart yield additive independent conditional variances, exactly one per successful time. Each success has probability at least epsilon^(degree+4)/2, giving the finite-T and limiting estimates. An independently executable exact-rational finite-state script passes 150 assertions. External variance-limit and CLT theorems inspected in arXiv:2207.01224 are explicitly attributed.

value.rationale: The theorem settles the 2022 primary source's explicit uncertainty about sublinear fluctuations for the unthinned local repetition count, uniformly for any finite or infinite locally finite graph. It supplies a nonasymptotic degree-local lower bound and implies nondegenerate normal limits using the original source theorems. This changes the usable scope of a graph-inference statistic rather than adding a routine finite numerical special case.
